Subject: Executive sponsor mapping & EB meeting request — MAP + eval timelines

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Auburn Health liked the latency profiles and the cost breakouts. We need to formalize a mutual action plan (MAP) and an evaluation plan so our EB (executive board) can sign off on timelines. Two asks from our side:

1) Can you draft a MAP that maps Redwood milestones to our procurement and security gating (SOC2 evidence, retention policy, audit log access)?
2) Can we schedule a 60–75 minute EB briefing with execs present (our CIO, procurement lead + your exec sponsor) the week of Jun 14–18? We need the slot to include a short demo, risk/controls overview, and a Q&A.

I attached a seed MAP template we use internally (Auburn_MAP_template.xlsx).

Also looping Samir (procurement) — he will drive contract windows and SSO/KMS questions.

Thanks,
Elena Ortiz
Head of Digital Platforms
Auburn Health

Date: Fri, 4 Jun 2027 12:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Executive sponsor mapping & EB meeting request — MAP + eval timelines

Elena — great to hear and thanks for the clear asks. I put together a first-pass MAP and an EB briefing agenda that ties to your procurement gates. Attached: RWI_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx and RWI-EB-Agenda.pdf.

High-level proposal:
- Week 1 (Jun 14–18): EB briefing + live demo (60–75 mins). Objective: sponsor alignment and confirm controls coverage.
- Week 2: Technical eval (two-engineer spike + performance eval). Outputs: perf report, KV-caching plan, and cost estimates.
- Week 3: Security evidence handoff + procurement redline window.

Suggested EB attendees from our side: myself (GRace OConnor, Sales Director), Marissa Cole (Head of Customer Success) — she'll own onboarding cadence, and an exec sponsor from Product/Platform. Ben, can you be internal exec sponsor or recommend a Platform exec?

Proposed times (all ET): Jun 15 13:00–14:15, Jun 16 10:00–11:15, Jun 17 15:00–16:15. If any of those work, we’ll lock the calendar and share an agenda.

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm preferred slot + add any additional Auburn stakeholders.
- Samir: if you can share the procurement checklist, we’ll map deliverables.
- Ben/Marissa: please review the MAP and add implementation owners in the draft.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0132
Attachment: RWI_MAP_DRAFT_v1.xlsx (xlsx); RWI-EB-Agenda.pdf (pdf)

Adding a quick note on the evaluation plan and EB ask.

Marissa here — I recommend we frame the EB briefing to emphasize:
- Risk & mitigations (data residency, KMS integration, audit log access) — Karthik, can you prepare a 10–12 minute segment on hosting and encryption options?
- Measured rollout timeline: can we show a week-by-week MAP with decision points? I added the gating points in the draft.
- Ask the Auburn execs for a commit window (e.g., 30 days) after EB if procurement clears redlines.

For the technical eval we propose: 48–72 hour perf run on representative dataset + an embedding rerank smoke test. Deliverables will be a PDF eval report and a short recording of the demo.

I’ll jump on the EB call for the onboarding plan and initial success metrics.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success | Redwood Inference
